label: a wristwatch.
why: A cartoon wristwatch with a round numbered face and a strap running up and down fills the frame in front view on a man's wrist. The watch holds almost still; only the dissolves at each end change the picture. It is the only wristwatch shot, between the dissolve from the desk clock at 11.0 to 11.25 s and the dissolve to the men at the table at 13.25 to 13.5 s, so the interval is the full 2.0 s of the shot.
